reviews.text: I've been bringing my two dogs and one cat to him, and he always treats them with such care and friendliness. It truly makes each visit a positive experience.
I've had great experiences at this vet with my cat.  The doctor is also very responsive over email.
I've been going here for many years.  It's the best Dr Koto takes care of my dogs for many many years now.

They handled my dog’s local registration, annual vaccines, and heartworm + flea and tick medicine. For these small services, no appointment is required and I walked in during open hours and did not have to wait.
